Claim: `domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`, branch `claude/issue-7230-fls-gate-expand-five-sites`.

Dispatched to one `os-dev` agent this round. File surface declared: `packages/plugin-calendar/src/**`, `packages/plugin-gantt/src/**`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/**`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/**`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, plus a test file per site.

⚠️ One sequencing constraint the dispatch carries, recorded here because it may change what this PR contains. The console eager-closure budget currently has **177 bytes** of repo-wide headroom on the `framework` per-chunk ceiling (`main` measures 523,823 B against 524,000), which is the subject of #7399 and is the maintainer's to rule. Four of the five sites are in plugin packages that the console loads lazily; `RecordDetailView.tsx` is in `app-shell`, which is in the eager closure. The dispatch requires the implementer to **measure** rather than assume that split, and if the `app-shell` site is what puts the chunk over, to drop that one site from this PR, file it as a follow-up carrying `Blocked-by: #7399`, and say so in the PR body. Scope is not narrowed silently — either all five land, or the omission is visible on this card.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #7428 at `96a284fe2`. All five sites landed; nothing was split out.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Reviewed from the diff and from `origin/main`, ⛔ not from the report. Enqueue follows once every check is green (21 success / 3 skipped / 6 running / **0 failed** at time of writing).

### The eager-closure constraint did not bind, and that is now established three independent ways

The dispatch required this be measured and the `app-shell` site dropped if it pushed `framework` over. It did not move **one byte**:

| chunk | `bf244f400` | `96a284fe2` |
|---|---:|---:|
| `framework` | 523,823 B | **523,823 B** |
| `vendor-objectstack` | 948,329 B | 948,329 B |
| `ui-components` | 396,598 B | 396,598 B |

1. The implementer's reading, from two real console builds, with the three chunks keeping their **content hash** — byte-identical files, which is the right control for "unchanged".
2. **My own structural check**: `apps/console/vite.config.ts:742` defines the group as `{ name: 'framework', test: /[\\/]packages[\\/](core|react|types)[\\/]/ }`. `app-shell` is not a member and **cannot route there**, so the site was never a `framework` risk in the first place.
3. **CI agrees independently**: `Bundle Analysis` passes with no per-chunk failure, and its own package table puts the movement exactly where it should be — `plugin-calendar` 47.00→47.14, `plugin-dashboard` 132.63→132.79, `plugin-detail` 251.20→251.27, `plugin-gantt` 167.03→167.18 — while `app-shell (index.js)` is unchanged at 15.67 KB, because `RecordDetailView` is its own chunk.

⇒ **#7399 is not blocked by this PR** and its 177 B of headroom is intact.

### ⭐ The card was wrong about `DetailView`, and the correction is the most valuable thing here

The card lists it as "passes a column list, ungated". Measured, it is **input-gated** — `allFields` comes from `gatedSchema`, already FLS-filtered field by field. That is the route PR #7229 measured as unsound and rejected, and at this site it does not merely under-protect, it **widens**:

> `buildExpandFields` reads an **empty** column list as "no column restriction" and falls back to every declared relation.

So a detail view whose authored fields are all denied had its column list gated down to `[]` and its `$expand` widened from the relations it asked for to **every relation the object declares** — the request grows precisely where the principal may read least. Same widening with no authored field list at all. Both pinned, with the measured payload `['account','secret_account','owner_dept']` against an expected `[]`.

⭐ And the implementer **named which of its own pins do not discriminate**: `DetailView`'s PIN 1 and PIN 2 are green in both directions because the input filter already covers the ordinary case, so they are labelled non-discriminating in the file rather than counted as evidence. A green pin proves nothing on its own; saying so in the file is the discipline.

### The card undercounted, and the remainder is filed

The card says `buildExpandFields` "is called from five more places". **I re-derived this myself on `origin/main`**: 13 production call sites, minus #7229's two, is **eleven** outside that PR's scope — and one of the card's five (`ObjectDataTable`) is `computeLookupExpand`, a different helper. Seven remain ungated after this PR: `plugin-kanban:284`, `plugin-tree:454`, `plugin-view:908`, `plugin-map:707`, `ObjectGallery:312`, `plugin-timeline:199`, `PagePreview:134` — and **all seven pass no column list**, the same maximal-expansion shape as the three sharpest here. Filed as **#7429**, unassigned and unlabelled for triage, with a sizing note on which are lazy.

Also confirmed by me: three of the card's five line numbers were stale (`350`→351, `674`→675). ⚠️ Verified rather than taken on trust — the same class of claim from another dev this shift was itself wrong.

### Correct calls worth recording

- The gate is on each helper's **output** at every site, copied from #7229 rather than re-derived, so the "`checkField` answers false for an undeclared key" trap stays **structurally** unreachable rather than avoided by convention. On the three no-column-list sites there is no input to gate at all.
- `usePermissions()` moved ~670 lines up in `RecordDetailView` because a dependency array is evaluated **during** render — listing `perms` while the binding was declared below would throw `Cannot access 'perms' before initialization`, a crash rather than a stale value. The later site destructures instead of re-calling, so hook order is unchanged.
- An unanswered policy filters nothing (`isLoaded: false` is the no-provider default), and `perms` is in each dependency list, so the projection rebuilds when the answer lands.
- Grading kept narrow and honest: defence-in-depth against ObjectStack's own server (`FieldMasker.maskRecord` deletes the key the expansion is written back under), load-bearing for a non-enforcing backend, and "no deployed non-enforcing backend is in use" explicitly **not** established.

## Landed — verified BY CONTENT on `origin/main`, with a control

PR #7428 merged through the queue at 2026-09-03T02:32:20Z. `main` `39af82fb4` → **`6411def25`**. `pm:dispatched` stripped in the same pass.

Baseline taken on `39af82fb4` **before** the merge, so both sides of every delta are real readings, ⛔ not the PR's head SHA:

| site | `checkField` before → after |
|---|---:|
| `plugin-calendar/ObjectCalendar.tsx` | 0 → **2** |
| `plugin-gantt/ObjectGantt.tsx` | 0 → **2** |
| `app-shell/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` | 0 → **2** |
| `plugin-dashboard/ObjectDataTable.tsx` | 0 → **2** |
| `plugin-detail/DetailView.tsx` | **1 → 3** |

All five new per-site test files present. **Control:** `buildExpandFields(` stays at exactly **1** occurrence at each site on both sides — the helper call was neither duplicated nor removed, so the movement above is the gate arriving rather than the call site being rewritten.

⭐ **`DetailView` going 1 → 3 rather than 0 → 2 is the card's own error visible in a single reading.** The card listed it as "passes a column list, ungated" — but it was the *only* one of the five already carrying a field check, and the pre-merge baseline shows exactly that asymmetry (1 against four zeros). It was input-gated, not ungated, and the implementer measured that the input gate **widens** the request: `buildExpandFields` reads an emptied column list as "no column restriction", so a detail view whose authored fields are all denied had its `$expand` grown from the relations it asked for to every relation the object declares. Both the pre-existing render-half check and the new projection gate are now present, which is why the count is 3.

The eager-closure constraint this seat attached to the dispatch **did not bind** and no site was split out: `framework` measured 523,823 B on both sides — delta **0** — corroborated three independent ways (the implementer's two builds with content-hash identity on all three eager chunks; this seat's reading that the `framework` group is `/[\\/]packages[\\/](core|react|types)[\\/]/`, which `app-shell` cannot match; and CI's own `Bundle Analysis`, green with no per-chunk failure). #7399 is untouched.

**Carried forward, open: #7429.** The card said `buildExpandFields` "is called from five more places"; re-derived on `main` it is **eleven** outside PR #7229's two, and **seven remain ungated** — `plugin-kanban:284`, `plugin-tree:454`, `plugin-view:908`, `plugin-map:707`, `ObjectGallery:312`, `plugin-timeline:199`, `PagePreview:134`. ⚠️ All seven pass **no column list**, i.e. the same maximal-expansion shape as the three sharpest closed here. Filed unassigned for triage grading with a per-site sizing note.
